method: Manual landmarks on original 1182x1330 image; 1148px height maps to 1.5m. Targets recorded before revision 1.3. Side depth approximate, not a strict silhouette gate.
foot_design: Unsegmented rounded forefoot as front/right/back reference; no separate toe lobes.
contour_trace_method: Corrected against original RGB pixels: G-R>10, G-B>30, G>80; choose central connected skin interval at rows 650/720/800. Row 850 additionally includes max(R,G,B)<120 for the charcoal waistband. Inclusive edge pixels; original rough manual bounds preserved separately. No model pixels used to set targets.
recording_note: Front baseline measurements predate 1.4. Additional side/head/ear targets recorded after initial 1.4 construction preview, before final contour iteration; do not claim all were pre-model measurements.

side.camera_note: Estimated from visible single eye and bolt face; not a recovered camera. True orthographic side also rendered.

head_front_rows_note: Source RGB boundary trace in head-only X window 350..829: G-R>10, G-B>30, G>80. Fixed reference measurements, no candidate pixels.
acceptance: Technical checks and existing front measured dimensions are independent from human visual contour review.
